author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I just use Github projects as my orchestration layer for my AI agents.  Every coding agent knows Github.  Github issue is essentially a message board.  The AI(s) can take care of the co-ordination among themselves.

A message board is all you need, AI can take care of the rest, that's what OpenAI's hack taught me.
